title: Allow dry-run without Jira credentials or Jira library.
commit_message: Allow dry-run without Jira credentials or Jira library.
diff:
diff --git a/generate-milestone-jira-cards b/generate-milestone-jira-cards
index 4e2b178..d2cd5f7 100755
--- a/generate-milestone-jira-cards
+++ b/generate-milestone-jira-cards
@@ -36,8 +36,6 @@ from datetime import date, timedelta
 import argparse
 import yaml
 
-from jira import JIRA
-
 
 JIRA_URL = 'https://warthogs.atlassian.net'
 
@@ -63,9 +61,11 @@ def create_milestone(milestone, template_file, release_date,
 
     milestone_release = date.fromisoformat(release_date)
 
-    jira = JIRA(basic_auth=(jira_credentials['jira_user'],
-                            jira_credentials['jira_token']),
-                server=JIRA_URL)
+    if not dry_run:
+        from jira import JIRA
+        jira = JIRA(basic_auth=(jira_credentials['jira_user'],
+                                jira_credentials['jira_token']),
+                    server=JIRA_URL)
 
     milestone_data = {
         'project': jira_project,
@@ -155,13 +155,14 @@ if __name__ == '__main__':
     args = parser.parse_args()
 
     jira_credentials = {}
-    with open(args.credentials) as fp:
-        jira_credentials = yaml.safe_load(fp)
-
-    if ('jira_user' not in jira_credentials or
-            'jira_token' not in jira_credentials):
-        print(f'Missing JIRA credentials (looked in {args.credentials})!')
-        sys.exit(1)
+    if not args.dry_run:
+        with open(args.credentials) as fp:
+            jira_credentials = yaml.safe_load(fp)
+
+        if ('jira_user' not in jira_credentials or
+                'jira_token' not in jira_credentials):
+            print(f'Missing JIRA credentials (looked in {args.credentials})!')
+            sys.exit(1)
 
     create_milestone(args.milestone, args.template, args.release_date,
                      args.jira_project, jira_credentials, args.dry_run,
